title: Approve the customer sign-in composition
question: These three comps use the customer sign-in direction you selected. Which one should be the build reference? What should carry forward, what feels false, and should it be approved, combined, revised, or rejected?

options.label: Centered sign-in
options.lineage: The clean, familiar Showoff sign-in screen you selected
options.thesis: A centered form keeps account access direct and predictable.
options.viewport: A horizontal account-progress row sits above the centered sign-in panel; providers lead, email and password follow, and one blue Continue button anchors the form.
options.risk: The restrained interface may need extra care in typography and spacing to feel distinct to Showoff.

options.label: Progress rail and sign-in panel
options.lineage: The same clean Showoff form with persistent setup progress at left
options.thesis: A side rail makes the next organization setup steps visible during sign-in.
options.viewport: The Account, Workspace, and Team sequence sits in a slim left rail beside a larger provider and credential form.
options.risk: The rail could take space away from the sign-in task on smaller screens.

options.label: Wide authentication panel
options.lineage: A broader form layout using the same familiar Showoff identity
options.thesis: A wide form puts both identity methods and credentials on one scan line.
options.viewport: A horizontal progress row leads into a wide panel with paired provider buttons, paired fields, and a full-width Continue action.
options.risk: The wider field layout must collapse cleanly to one column on phones.
